synopsis: The Star Wars Rebels: Transfer Activity Book is a children's activity book in the Star Wars Rebels series. It was published by Egmont UK Ltd on July 30, 2015.Fans of the Star Wars Rebels TV series will love this out-of-this-world activity book with more than 60 transfers! Use your transfers to create epic battle scenes, complete mind-boggling puzzles and design your own rebel look. Plus, learn all about your favourite rebels with cool trivia and word games. Have you got what it takes to join the Rebellion? Based on the award-winning animated television series that features the voices of Freddie Prinze JR, Sarah Michelle Geller, Jason Isaacs and James Earl Jones as Darth Vader, these thrilling Star Wars adventures will delight young rebels aged six and upwards. Do you own the complete Star Wars Rebels Activity range? Rebels Rule Activity Book; Star Wars Rebels 3D Activity Book; Star Wars Rebels How to Draw Activity Book; Star Wars Rebels Transfer Book; and, Star Wars Rebels Story and Activity Book.
title: Rebels: Transfer Activity Book
